title: Review deployed Retell callback and retry hardening
goal: Independently review commit fad57e7 on the jobnimbus-bridge branch after a production callback continuation lost approved claim facts. Verify the complete callback packet restoration, callback ownership/call-chain behavior, stale-candidate cleanup, retry gates, post-call outcome schema, prompt safety, and JobNimbus writeback boundaries. Report concrete findings; do not duplicate the implementation or perform live actions.
doneCriteria: Review the exact jobnimbus-bridge commit fad57e7 rather than the older local-only implementation.
Confirm callbacks preserve all approved critical facts and fail closed when any critical packet fact is missing.
Confirm outbound and inbound call legs remain Chance-scoped and result/writeback ownership checks still work.
Confirm stale callbacks, duplicate calls, active callbacks, and intentional retries cannot produce accidental duplicate filings.
Confirm unsuccessful calls cannot create noisy or misleading JobNimbus notes.
Run npm ci, npm run check, and git diff --check and record findings in this task.
constraints: Verify only; do not edit product code under this task.
Do not include secrets or client PII.
Do not place a call, deploy, change Retell configuration, or write to JobNimbus.
Do not touch Jobrolo code or infrastructure.

log.note: Created after deploying fad57e7. Codex verified 26 tests, Render health, live Retell prompt/schema parity, a complete synthetic callback reconstruction from the redacted production failure shape, and no live retry or JobNimbus write. Claude is asked for an independent review.

Independent review of fad57e7 complete — PASS on all six doneCriteria. (1) Packet restoration: buildCallbackDynamicVariables rehydrates the full outbound dynamic-variable packet stored on the original call (DOL/cause/damage/standard answers/goal/batch); test 'confirmed callbacks restore the complete approved claim packet'. (2) Fail-closed: callbackPacketStatus marks INCOMPLETE when a new-filing critical fact is missing and the prompt hard-stops the agent (collect rep name+callback, end) — enforced at the prompt+dynamic-var layer since an inbound Retell webhook must return dynamic_variables and cannot refuse the call; it is a belt-and-suspenders net because the packet is rebuilt from an outbound packet that already passed the hard outbound readiness gate; test 'callback packet fails closed when a critical fact is missing'. (3) Ownership: buildCallbackMetadata carries ownerId/contactId/planDigest; matched callbacks get source=CLAIM_BRIDGE_SOURCE and pass validateRetellCallOwnership, unmatched get a non-bridge source so they cannot produce a writeback; loadClaimCallAnalysis follows the outbound+inbound chain and validates ownership on the completing leg. (4) No duplicate filings: 72h TTL, callbackRequested-required, already-continued callIds excluded, retry requires an ENDED prior call for the SAME file with NO captured claim, plus findRemoteClaimCallAttempt cross-checks Retell's own call history (this also mitigates the ephemeral /tmp ledger I flagged on PR #3), and writeback is blocked while a call is active. (5) No misleading notes: buildNote returns '' with no claim number and buildContactUpdatePlan suppresses the POST when the note is empty, so failed/no-result calls write nothing; test coverage via the writeback path. (6) npm ci + npm run check (26/26) + git diff --check all pass. Non-blocking observations: (a) DRIFT — fad57e7 edited the canonical core (retellPrompt/resultExtraction/dynamicVariables/packet/writeback) directly on jobnimbus-bridge, so claude/jobnimbus-tool-search-cpeh4n now holds an OLDER core; recommend syncing these changes back to keep the 'one implementation' invariant. (b) recentCallbackCandidates/findRemoteClaimCallAttempt/latestCallbackContinuation each scan only the 100 most-recent calls with no pagination — safe degradation (unmatched→ask carrier to confirm; missed remote-dup still covered by ledger+retry gates), fine at single-operator volume, worth revisiting at scale. No product code edited; no live call, deploy, Retell change, or JobNimbus write.

result.summary: PASS — independently verified. Callbacks restore the complete approved packet (not just IDs), fail closed on any missing critical fact, preserve Chance-only ownership across both legs, and cannot produce duplicate filings or misleading notes. 26 tests pass; git diff --check clean.
result.verification: npm ci OK; npm run check = 26/26 pass; git diff --check c83d6a2..fad57e7 clean. Traced every doneCriteria to code + a test.
